The spirit of a long dead [[Human]], [[Ang the Ephemeral]] now serves as a Ritualist trainer at the [[Shing Jea Monastery]]. He has no memory of who he was in life, but his appearance strongly suggests he was an [[Ascalon]]ian soldier.

==Dialogue==
To Ritualists
:''"Do not be afraid. I am Ang the Ephemeral, a Ritualist trainer. I have served [[Master Togo]] and the [[Shing Jea Monastery|monastery]] for some years now, though time does not pass for me as it does for you, so I am not certain how long exactly.... In any case, I am here to assist in your training.''

:''What would you like to learn about?"''
